websiteObservedRollingWindow.title: Even Other AI Labs Are Rallying Around Anthropic’s Slowdown Proposal
websiteObservedRollingWindow.teaser: Dario Amodei's 'We Must Pace the Frontier' pulled Altman, Musk, Hassabis, and Nadella publicly on board with slowing AI down. Between the IPO cynics, the antitrust lawyers, and Beijing's 'Cold War' accusations, the negotiation over AI's next phase just started in earnest.

websiteObservedRollingWindow.title: 10 Ways to Think Bigger with Opportunity AI
websiteObservedRollingWindow.teaser: GPT-6 Astra confounds — coders are retreating while new capabilities like games, video pipelines, and 3D go unexplored. A weekend big-think with a dozen thought starters for opportunity AI, plus an interactive companion on the site.

websiteObservedRollingWindow.title: What to Use the Latest AI Tools For
websiteObservedRollingWindow.teaser: OpenAI hits a compute wall and pauses $200 Pro plans while a second wave of releases points at two big trends: voice-first interfaces and cheap, good-enough models. NLW rips through eight-plus launches — who each is for and what to actually do with it.

websiteObservedRollingWindow.title: Anthropic Researcher Says AI Has Over a 10% Chance of Killing All Humans
websiteObservedRollingWindow.teaser: An Anthropic researcher's resignation and a colleague's >10% doom odds went 200-million-views viral. NLW skips the outrage and unpacks why the decade-old x-risk message suddenly landed — and where the conversation should go next.

websiteObservedRollingWindow.title: AI Model Month Is Off to a Blistering Start
websiteObservedRollingWindow.teaser: Three new models, a personal agent, and a Millennium Prize solve wrapped in a scooping scandal. Model month is delivering capability, cost curves, and drama in equal measure.
